project.name: Gully Legends Prague
project.purpose: Gaming/comic styled cricket website, local match-management workflow, player progression system, Hall of Legends rankings, and Formula Room documentation for the Gully Legends Prague cricket group.
project.styling: Tailwind CSS plus custom CSS in app/globals.css
project.runtimeDataSource: Typed local TypeScript data, browser localStorage for local career progress and finalised match history, and server-side validation routes
project.phaseStatus: Dashboard, 16 player profiles, comic player dossier pages, local match-management workflow, XP/rating progression, Formula Room, and Hall of Legends leaderboard are implemented with real responsive components.

commands.windowsNote: Use npm.cmd in PowerShell because npm.ps1 may be blocked by execution policy.

mustDo: Keep navigation and buttons as genuine clickable elements.
Use next/image for approved raster assets when rendered in React.
Keep text readable on desktop, tablet, and mobile.
Keep visual style funky, comic, cricket/gaming themed.
mustNotDo: Do not use a full-page screenshot with invisible clickable hotspots.
Do not redesign approved assets or regenerate backgrounds unless explicitly asked.
Do not silently edit README.md or instruction files unless explicitly asked.
Do not expose private team-balancing weights in UI, public player data, API responses, labels, tooltips, logs, or accessibility text.

rules: Use this exact image.
Do not regenerate, repaint, blur heavily, recolor, replace, or modify it.
Important baked-in signs and wall text must remain visible.
Current hero uses full-width image rendering inside an overflow-hidden wrapper with limited top-sky crop only.
The emblem includes the Gully Legends title and No Rules. Only Fun! tagline.
Do not render a duplicate HTML tagline.
Do not increase navbar height to enlarge the logo.
Use the approved PNG files exactly.
Do not crop, resize source files, recolor, regenerate, or replace them.
Render complete cards with object-fit: contain.
The title is embedded in the PNG; do not render player.cardTitle as visible HTML on cards or detail pages.

usage: Stats / Formula Room - Player Power tab

dashboardState.venue: CZU Gully Arena - Open Field, Prague

hero.rendering: full-width image with height auto, inside overflow-hidden wrapper
hero.cropRule: only controlled top-sky crop; do not crop castle, signs, wall text, lower field, or side signboards

mainDashboardLayout.structure: two-column outer layout with independent left sidebar and separate main-content grid

topPerformers.currentDesign: Legend Spotlight cards for Most Runs, Most Wickets, and Most Catches only.
topPerformers.dataSource: Uses getLeaderboardEntries and getLeaderboardSummary from lib/leaderboard.ts; do not create separate dashboard calculations.
rules: Show one active leader stat per category.
Use circular player portraits from player.cardImage for active leaders.
Use approved category artwork only as a subtle watermark or zero-state icon.
Tie state shows JOINT LEADERS with overlapping portraits and links to the relevant Hall of Legends tab.
Zero state shows RACE NOT STARTED.
Header link text is View Hall of Legends and points to /leaderboard.

players.identityNote: Use existing canonical IDs only. Do not create duplicate records because of display-name spelling. Jogindar is the canonical ID/name currently in data.
contentFields: funTrait: legacy data; do not reuse as both hero and special move

playerDetailPage.purpose: Comic-style hero dossier for one player.
layoutRules: Render complete player.cardImage on the left with object-fit: contain.
Do not render cardTitle as visible HTML because it is printed in the PNG.
Player Power is numeric only and uses labels Blade Power, Delivery Threat, Field Reflex.
Player File uses descriptive labels Batting DNA, Bowling Arsenal, Fielding Instinct.
On-Field Special Move uses specialMoveName and specialMoveDescription only.
Do not repeat the same text in multiple sections.

iconRendering.componentPattern: components/players/PlayerProfile.tsx uses one shared PlayerProfileIcon renderer for Player Power and Player File icons.
iconRendering.visualTarget: Artwork should fill roughly 80-90% of the circular holder, matching Dashboard Monthly Beasts badges, using CSS transform inside overflow-hidden circles.

matchWorkflow.status: Local mock workflow with server routes for balancing/validation. No database persistence yet.

rules: Available Today checkboxes appear above Team A / Team B selectors.
Unavailable players cannot be assigned to teams.
Removing availability removes that player from Team A and Team B.
Availability affects only the current match.
Manual Team A and Team B checkboxes remain usable.
A player selected in Team A is disabled in Team B.
A player selected in Team B is disabled in Team A.
Toggling a player into one team removes them from the other team.
Server validation rejects duplicate cross-team membership.

algorithm: Resolve private neutral balance weights on the server.
Deduplicate and validate canonical player IDs.
Keep team-size difference no more than one.
Prefer lower roster size first, then lower accumulated private weight, then random.
privacy: Do not add balanceWeight to public player objects.
Do not import server/team-balancing.ts into client components.
Do not display strength, tier, ranking band, balance weight, or team power score in UI.

scorecardDataEntry.principle: Easy live-entry scorecard using innings totals, completed-over totals, and manually selected special events.
scorecardDataEntry.performanceRecord: PlayerMatchPerformance in lib/types/match.ts includes playerId, teamId, played, teamWon, playerOfMatch, didBat, runs, wasOut, wickets, overs, hatTricks, catches, runOuts, stumpings.

teamTotals.rule: Team total equals sum of selected players' runs only.
teamTotals.ui: Team A Total and Team B Total are read-only output values.
teamTotals.serverValidation: app/api/matches/validate/route.ts recalculates totals via server/match-validation.ts before save/submit mock actions.

localPersistence.rule: Finalised matches update local career stats and are saved to browser localStorage for Hall of Legends and dashboard summaries. This is not Supabase/database persistence.

runsInputFormatting.draftType: runs fields in editable player records support number | empty string
rules: When Did Bat changes from false to true, untouched Runs starts blank, not 0.
Typing 013 normalizes to numeric 13.
Typing 001 normalizes to numeric 1.
Clearing the field remains allowed while editing.
Empty Runs is treated as zero for calculations and saving.
Do not store raw input strings for Runs.

resultRules: First-batting team wins by first innings runs minus chasing innings runs.
Chasing team wins by wickets remaining, calculated as chasing team player count minus chasing wickets lost.
No Result is only for abandoned or cancelled matches.
inningsAndResultRules.previewLanguage: Live result preview must not declare projected winners before enough innings state exists.

rules: Draft and In-Progress matches keep the full data-entry layout.
Finalised matches become readable scorecards.
Show XP Awarded after finalisation.
Hide editing controls after finalisation.
Show each innings-complete notice once.
Collapse detailed overs and player records after finalisation.
Use subtle team accent colours to distinguish teams.
Do not display development terms such as Mock Match Entry, Mock Match, Demo Match, Test Match Entry, or Sample Match.

distinction.hallOfLegends: Who is leading and where does everyone rank?
distinction.formulaRoom: How are XP, Levels, ratings and cricket results calculated?

dataRules: Use finalised successful matches only for ranking statistics.
Current Month uses matchDate parsed into the user's local calendar month.
ISO YYYY-MM-DD and legacy DD/MM/YYYY match dates are supported.
Podium excludes zero-value leaders for runs, wickets, catches, and XP.
Level 0 can show all players tied when no player has progressed.
doNotRename: Do not rename the app/leaderboard folder unless the user explicitly asks.

formulaRoom.rule: Do not maintain separate display formulas and calculation formulas.
sourceOfTruth: shared constants and utilities used by real calculations

matchXPFormula.maidenXP: overs where maiden or runsConceded === 0, times 5

ratings.numericDisplayRule: Only show numeric rating after at least 3 finalised matches.
bladePower: 60% percentile rank of runs per batting innings
deliveryThreat: 55% percentile rank of wickets per bowling match
30% reversed percentile rank of bowling economy
fieldReflex: 65% percentile rank of catches per match
35% percentile rank of run-outs per match

coverageThemes: team balancing availability and roster validity
private weights not returned in client result shape
Hall of Legends current-month filtering and competition ranking
tests.generatedArtifact: .test-build is generated by npm run test and should not be committed.

lastVerified.result: All passed after the latest Dashboard Top Performers, Hall of Legends, Formula Room, match workflow, and Player Profile icon updates.

beforeVisualChanges: Inspect design-reference/gully-legends-dashboard.png and exact approved assets relevant to the request.
Do not make generic redesigns when the user asks for targeted changes.
beforeMatchWorkflowChanges: Inspect lib/types/match.ts, lib/match-records.ts, lib/progression.ts, server/team-balancing.ts, server/match-validation.ts, and components/matches/MockMatchEntryForm.tsx.
Keep scorecard entry simple and live-match friendly.
Preserve server-only privacy of team-balancing data.
filesystemSafety: Do not reset or revert user changes.
Do not delete or modify approved image assets unless explicitly requested.
Clean generated .test-build after running tests if it appears.
